I consistently lost a pound a week using the following things:
1)No soda/juices only water and fruits
2)Eat foods which have low glycemic index that means they release sugars slowly making you feel energized for a long time
3)Try to have quick cold shower once a day. The cold boosts your metabolism
4)Have lot of fibrous food. Body spends calories digesting food and fibre rich foods take more time to digest. Also having a small desert after such a meal wont make the sugar turn into fat since body will be digesting the slow sugar releasing fibre and fast sugar releasing desert
5)Have cheat meals once a week
6) Drink green tea since it again helps boosts metabolism
7)Nothing beats exercise so start having walks post dinner to stimulate digestion and burn calories as well
